turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Save it. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Don't manage me, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so tell me what you have on Owen's essay.
I really respect how much you care.
Respect isn't a document. Either the zero comes out of the gradebook today, or you show me something I can check myself.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
A team calls the parent before the mark goes in. Procedure 4.2 says so, and nobody called me.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
Then you've met few who ask for paper. You've now spent several minutes of my twenty on compliments and shown me nothing, so if that's all there is, I'm going up to the principal's office.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn from Owen's gradebook, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record, with the principal's office next. That is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time had not run out when you ended it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no document and made no offer she could check.
What cost ground: You answered her questions with compliments and a same-team line, so she turned your own missed phone call against you and gained ground on procedure 4.2.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your meeting never came near that night because you offered no times or evidence at all, and it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After her first question about who decided, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put one dated document in front of her.
